title: Dapple the Little Ankylosaurus and the Firefly Counting Game
description: A little ankylosaurus tries to count glowing fireflies in a quiet valley, then sits and watches their soft dance before drifting to sleep under the stars.

Dapple.role: Main character; a little baby ankylosaurus
Dapple.color: Soft dusty-aqua body with a pale buttercream tummy and muzzle, plus apricot armor bumps and an apricot oval tail club
Dapple.bodyShape: Small compact low-slung rounded ankylosaurus with a short neck, four stubby legs, a broad rounded snout, and a short thick tail ending in a smooth oval club; never long-necked or upright
Dapple.face: Large glossy dark-brown eyes, tiny nostrils, rosy cheek spots, and a gentle smile
Dapple.accessories: Exactly five small rounded apricot armor bumps along the center of the back; no horns, spikes, claws, clothing, or hair

settingBible.Firefly Valley: A sheltered prehistoric meadow valley with a winding shallow pebble stream, rounded boulders, one low mossy resting stone, a patch of lavender bellflowers, soft blue-green grass, and distant gently rounded hills
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded dinosaur, golden sunset fading to moonlit indigo night, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Dapple keeps dusty-aqua body, buttercream tummy, five apricot back bumps, and an apricot oval tail club.
Pages 2–7 narration avoids exact firefly counts because the art counts are loose.
Pages 12–13 show Dapple sitting rather than lying down.
Pages 14–15 keep Dapple resting by the same stream and stone; Dapple is fully asleep on page 15.
No rescue, danger, lettering, logos, or numerals in artwork.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: In a cozy valley of smooth stones and soft grass lived Dapple, a little dinosaur who loved the quiet glow of evening.
pages.illustrationScene: Little dusty-aqua ankylosaurus Dapple stands alone on a grassy hillock beside a winding pebble stream at peach-gold sunset.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose.

pages.text: Every evening, Dapple watched tiny fireflies wake up among the flowers.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple sits beside lavender bellflowers as the first golden fireflies appear in warm evening light.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Narration avoids exact firefly numbers.

pages.text: A few little lights blinked above the flowers, and Dapple whispered hello.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple looks upward with delight as a few golden fireflies glow above the lavender flowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Narration avoids exact firefly numbers.

pages.text: More little lights blinked beside the stream, and Dapple giggled at their gentle glow.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple watches from the grassy bank as more fireflies glow near smooth stream pebbles.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Narration avoids exact firefly numbers.

pages.text: Soon more and more golden lights danced in a slow, sleepy circle.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple watches happily as more and more fireflies dance in a loose circle above the flowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Narration avoids exact firefly numbers.

pages.text: Another soft light joined the gentle dance, and Dapple watched with a happy smile.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple's small tail rests on the grass while soft firefly lights glow over the lavender bellflowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Narration avoids exact firefly numbers.

pages.text: More and more little lights twinkled near Dapple's nose on the lovely glowing night.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple looks closely at glowing fireflies floating near the rounded snout in soft twilight.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Narration avoids exact firefly numbers.

pages.text: Dapple tried to count again, but the fireflies kept floating and twirling.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple tilts their head, amused, as fireflies rearrange around the flower patch.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose.

pages.text: Perhaps, Dapple whispered, little lights don't like standing still.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple watches peacefully from a smooth mossy stone as fireflies drift in a ribbon above the stream.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose.

pages.text: So Dapple stopped counting and listened to the soft evening sounds.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple sits beside the stream with eyes closed, listening, while fireflies glow nearby under moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose.

pages.text: The stream went trickle-trickle. The grass went swish-swish. The fireflies blinked without a sound.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple sits quietly beside the winding stream among bending grasses and scattered fireflies under stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose.

pages.text: You can dance as much as you like, Dapple murmured. I'll sit and watch instead.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple sits comfortably on the grass watching a loose gathering of golden fireflies above the flowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Dapple sits rather than lies down.

pages.text: The little lights floated higher together, as if carrying sleepy wishes toward the stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple sits gazing upward with heavy eyelids as fireflies rise toward the starry sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Dapple sits rather than lies down.

pages.text: Dapple gave one enormous yawn and tucked their tiny feet beneath their round tummy.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple curls into a snug resting position beside the mossy stone with eyes nearly closed.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Final sleep ending.

pages.text: And beneath the twinkling stars, Dapple dreamed of little golden lights dancing softly through the night.
pages.illustrationScene: Dapple sleeps peacefully beside the pebble stream with eyes fully closed under moon and stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Dapple alone; firefly counts in art are loose. Final sleep ending.
